guidance_log.original: To assist you better, I need to identify you as a customer. Could you please provide your phone number, or your full name along with your date of birth?

Thank you, John. Since you are abroad in France, I will check the roaming status and other settings to help you send MMS messages successfully. First, let's make sure your phone is not in airplane mode, as that can prevent sending MMS. Please toggle airplane mode on your device (turn it on and then off) using the toggle_airplane_mode() action. Let me know once you have done that.

Please toggle mobile data ON on your device next using the toggle_data() action. This will enable your cellular data connection which is necessary for sending MMS messages. Let me know once you have done this.

Please try to reseat your SIM card on your device. This means removing the SIM card and inserting it back properly to ensure it is correctly seated. Use the reseat_sim_card() action for this. Let me know once you have done this.

Since your phone is connected to a 2G network, which is insufficient for MMS, please change your network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred for better connectivity and MMS support. Use the action set_network_mode_preference(mode=4g_5g_preferred) on your device. Let me know after you have done that.

Next, please check if Wi-Fi Calling is enabled on your device, as it may interfere with MMS. After checking, please toggle Wi-Fi Calling off using the toggle_wifi_calling() action. Let me know once you have done this.

Please reset the APN settings on your device to ensure the correct settings for MMS. Use the reset_apn_settings() action on your device. After that, you will need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Please let me know once you have reset the APN settings.
